verdict.rationale: Ollama is a model runtime and an agent-launching tool, and nothing in the evidence shows it offers its own way to set up automations that run in the background, such as scheduled or triggered jobs. The closest items are ollama launch for coding agents and the third-party OpenClaw assistant, but those are integrations with other agents or are REST APIs and SDKs that serve as developer building blocks. None of them is a first-party automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
